ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure draws the outline of China. The Western Pacific Subtropical High is located in the near-sea area of southeastern China, and a rain belt is marked near the north side of the subtropical high; on the right side there is a label "warm and humid airflow", whose arrow direction is drawn inconsistent with the direction of transport from the ocean to the rain belt in eastern China. Then reason: The Northern Hemisphere subtropical high is an anticyclonic circulation, and the warm and humid airflow affecting eastern China on its west side should come from the southern and southeastern oceans and be transported toward the mainland and the frontal rain belt. The arrow direction of "warm and humid airflow" in the figure is opposite or does not conform to this circulation law, so the obviously wrong label is "warm and humid airflow".

raw_record.question_text:
The Western Pacific Subtropical High (abbreviated as subtropical high) is an important weather system affecting mainland China. The main frontal rain belt in eastern China is usually located 5~8 degrees of latitude north of the subtropical high ridge line, and moves with the northward advance and southward retreat of the subtropical high. The following figure is a schematic diagram drawn by a student of the influence of the subtropical high on China's weather.

<image1>

In the schematic diagram drawn by this student, which label is obviously wrong?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: note the position of the subtropical high southeast of China and the direction drawn for the arrow labeled “暖湿气流.” Then apply the Northern Hemisphere subtropical-high circulation rule: the warm moist flow affecting eastern China should come from the ocean on the south/southeast and move toward the mainland/rain-belt area along the high’s western flank. Compare this expected direction with the drawn “暖湿气流” arrow. Because the diagram’s warm-moist-flow arrow is drawn in the wrong direction relative to the subtropical high circulation, identify “暖湿气流” as the obviously wrong label/marking.
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中画出中国轮廓，西太平洋副热带高压位于我国东南部近海一带，副高北侧附近标有雨带；右侧有“暖湿气流”标注，其箭头方向画得与从海洋输送到我国东部雨带的方向不一致。再推理：北半球副热带高压为反气旋性环流，其西侧影响我国东部的暖湿气流应来自南部、东南部海洋，向大陆和锋面雨带输送。图中“暖湿气流”的箭头方向相反或不符合这一环流规律，所以明显错误的标注是“暖湿气流”。
